definitions.explanation: A female parent. More formal or objective than {母|はは} (my mother) or お{母|かあ}さん.

examples.japanese: {母親|ははおや}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧。
examples.english: I feel responsibility as a mother.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{母親|ははおや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{教師|きょうし}→教師：03029_kyoushi⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
{母親|ははおや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{愛情|あいじょう}→愛情：01673_aijou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧。
{母親|ははおや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{似|に}ている→似る：01159_niru⟧。

⟦{実|じつ}→実：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{母親|ははおや}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}った→会う：00482_au⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{大人|おとな}→大人：02856_otona⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なって→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧⟦{再会|さいかい}し→再会：11667_saikai⟧、⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まらなかった→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧。
examples.english: I had never met my biological mother, but when we reunited for the first time as an adult, I couldn't stop crying.
examples.notes: ⟦{実|じつ}→実：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{母親|ははおや} = biological mother

notes:
USAGE: {母親|ははおや} is a neutral/objective term for 'mother.' It's used when discussing mothers in general or referring to someone else's mother in a neutral way.

FAMILY TERM COMPARISON:
- ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧ - my mother (humble, when speaking to others)
- {母親|ははおや} - mother (neutral, objective)
- ⟦お{母|かあ}さん→お母さん：02851_okaasan⟧ - mother, mom (familiar, can be used for others' mothers too)
- ⟦ママ→ママ：03155_mama⟧ - mommy (casual)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {母親|ははおや}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧ (as a mother)
- {母親|ははおや}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧ (mother's love)
- ⟦{片|かた}{親|おや}→片親：27516_kataoya⟧ (single parent)
- ⟦{実|じつ}→実：noentry⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{母親|ははおや} (biological mother)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{父親|ちちおや}→父親：03469_chichioya⟧ (father)
